lwIP 2.2.0 (https://savannah.nongnu.org/projects/lwip/), BSD licence
(COPYING).  The IPv6 sources in src/core/ipv6 come from the Debian/Ubuntu
source tarball lwip_2.2.0+dfsg1.orig.tar.xz (the upstream 2.2.0 files).
The configuration is kernel/net/port/lwipopts.h.

NovaOS changes:
- src/core/ipv6/nd6.c: a DNS server from a router advertisement (RDNSS)
  goes in the first free DNS slot instead of replacing the servers DHCPv4
  set (marked "NovaOS:").
- src/core/ipv6/dhcp6.c, src/include/lwip/dhcp6.h, src/include/lwip/prot/dhcp6.h:
  stateful DHCPv6 (RFC 8415), which lwIP 2.2.0 leaves unimplemented: one
  IA_NA with one address, its DNS servers and domain search list, Renew at
  T1, Rebind at T2, Release and Decline, retransmitted as section 15 says;
  dhcp6_release/dhcp6_renew/dhcp6_link_changed for the kernel (marked
  "NovaOS:").  nd6.c leaves the leased address's lifetimes to DHCPv6 when
  its prefix is also advertised for SLAAC.
